summary: The roadmap's final deliverable is one study report drawn from every trial report. Its figures should come from the committed per-trial outputs, not be copied by hand, so the report can be regenerated and checked.  trial_report.py --study takes one --trial JSON output per study, recognised by content: the progression report (study A), the --pvp report (study C), the --fleet report (study D) and a market trial result (R4). No market report exists yet, so a minimal market-trial result format (version 1) is defined and documented as provisional until SPEC-09 adds --market; market return counts completed trades only.  For every study, in a fixed order, the aggregate states the question, arms, windows, game versions, sample sizes and minimum, the primary result per arm with its 95% interval, the decide() outcome (regenerated from pooled known results for study C, whose report has none), costs, failures and the trial's limitations (R1). A study with no output, short of its minimum sample, or without an adopt/reject decision is reported as inconclusive with its reasons and never omitted; a stopped trial is aborted (R4). No current time enters the report and sources are identified by file name and a short SHA-256, so the same outputs give byte-identical JSON and Markdown (R6). The progression, --pvp and --fleet reports are unchanged; --plan is now required by every mode except --study. Implemented by the SPEC-12 builder specialist subagent in an isolated worktree, independently reviewed by the verifier subagent (tests cite S12-R1, R4, R6; parent re-validated in a scratch clone), and re-validated by the parent.
